answer: The basalt schedule is applied in karst and ivory reveals each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 53% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2352 identities would post 3271 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
